name: g_powersOfFour
comment: Lookup table of powers of 4 (4^0 through 4^15, i.e. 1 << 2*k). Used in 2D quad/quadtree indexing and map chip trace routines to calculate pyramid level offsets via (4^k - 1) / 3.
evidence: Array of 16 u32 values at 0x00727BF0 in .rodata: 0x1, 0x4, 0x10, 0x40 ... 0x40000000. Indexed by Field2D_MapChip_WalkTrace (literal 0x005CAFAC) and maybe_Font_GlyphQuad_CreateFromUVs; subtracting 1 and multiplying by 0xAAAAAAAB >> 33 computes (4^k - 1) / 3 for quadtree and tile pyramid level offsets.

name: g_spriteLayerConfigs
comment: Configuration table of callback and flag pairs for 2D actor sprite layers and font glyph quad UV buffers, determining visibility and render hooks.
evidence: Table of six 8-byte callback/flag pairs in .rodata referenced by literals 0x002B3A54 (maybe_Actor2D_UpdateSpritePositions), 0x002B3AC4 (Font_GlyphQuad_SetUV), and 0x002B3B7C (Font_GlyphQuad_SetUVTriple). Fields +0x24/+0x28 and +0x2C/+0x30 control UV buffer enable in func_0070BBE4; +0x04..+0x20 configure 2D actor sprite layers.

name: g_fontDisplayListCommandTemplate

evidence: Emitted at the start of Font_BuildDisplayList (0x005593E4) via Container_ByteBuffer_Append(self + 1, 0x0072F530, 8) from literal 0x00559898; contains PICA200 register write 0x00000001 to GPUREG_PRIMITIVE_CONFIG (0x02BF). Also serves as base for numerous command word offsets throughout Font_BuildDisplayList.

name: g_fontVertexAttrComponentOffsets
